name: telemath_stats_2xA100_Sep2026
_note: Per-cluster TRAINING statistics for the nine-model TeleMath pool, measured on 2 x A100 (tensor parallel 2) at concurrency 32 under vLLM 0.19.0, k = 4 clusters over the 299-question train split. Cost ordering changes between clusters for 2 of 36 model pairs under TPOT and 3 of 36 under E2EL. Fit it with `cre fit --stats configs/telemath_stats_2xA100_Sep2026.json --budget 20` or `--cost-metric e2el --budget 25000`, and add `--cost-conditioning cluster` to price cost per (model, cluster).
